integrity: The proof separates the exact simplicial join identity, the deformation retraction of each same-type clique complex to the incidence graph, and the graph cycle-rank calculation. Computational checks are explicitly supplementary. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite thick generalized quadrangles with the unweighted incidence-graph metric and inclusive scales 3<=r<4. The finite verifier checks only W(3,2) and W(3,3); the general conclusion is supplied by the axiomatic proof, not by enumeration.
title: Scale-three Vietoris–Rips complexes of finite generalized quadrangles
